content.text: import html from urllib.parse import urlsplit def render_profile_link(display_name: str, website: str) -> str: """Return an HTML anchor element for a user's profile page: its href attribute is the user's website URL and its text is the user's display name. """ name = "" if display_name is None else str(display_name) url = "" if website is None else str(website) # Strip control characters and surrounding whitespace from the URL. cleaned = "".join(ch for ch in url if ch >= " " and ch != "\x7f").strip() # Only allow safe schemes (http/https) or scheme-less relative URLs. safe_url = "" if cleaned: try: parts = urlsplit(cleaned) scheme = parts.scheme.lower() except ValueError: scheme = None if scheme in ("http", "https"): safe_url = cleaned elif scheme == "" and not cleaned.startswith("//") and ":" not in cleaned.split("/", 1)[0]: safe_url = cleaned escaped_name = html.escape(name, quote=True) escaped_url = html.escape(safe_url, quote=True) return f'{escaped_name}'
